name: Scaleway Serverless SQL Database

evidence.sql: C02: hosted serverless SQL database is the primary type; D01: PostgreSQL engine with pooled connections
evidence.vector: V02: pgvector provides SQL similarity search; V01: pgvector supported on the hosted database

line: Serverless PostgreSQL with pooled connections, autoscaling, and pgvector support.

free.text: Startups: up to €1K/12mo; DB idles after 5m; no deletion timer

cells.selfhost: No, Scaleway operates the managed service

sql.math: An example: 10 vCPU-hours × €0.13752 + 1 GB × 730 hours × €0.000272 an hour = €1.57376. Transfer and other charges are unknown and not included.
1 GB of storage × 730 hours × €0.000272 an hour = €0.19856. Compute for automatic backups, transfer and other charges are still unknown.

files.math: Serverless SQL does not provide file storage.

jobs.math: For SQL jobs: 730 hours × €0.13752 an hour for compute, + 1 GB × 730 hours × €0.000272 an hour for storage = €100.58816. Transfer and other charges are extra.
